meta.title: Jhonatan Domingos · Software Engineer | Custom systems
meta.description: I build custom systems, automations and integrations for companies still relying on spreadsheets and manual processes. I also modernize old systems holding back business growth.

whatsappMessage: Hi Jhonatan! I saw your website and would like to talk about a project.

hero.title: Is your company losing time to manual processes? That can become a system.
hero.sub1: I build custom systems, automations and integrations for companies still relying on spreadsheets, copy-paste and repetitive tasks. I also modernize old systems holding back business growth.

sobre.bio1: I help companies stop depending on spreadsheets, manual work, and systems that don't talk to each other.
sobre.bio2: Before thinking about technology, I understand your business's real process: where time is lost, where rework happens, where human error creeps in. Only then do I design the solution: a new system, an automation, an integration between tools you already use, or the modernization of something old that still works but nobody wants to touch anymore.
sobre.bio3: I bring the same discipline I use on large-scale corporate projects, systems used by thousands of people, with high demands for security and stability. The difference is you talk directly to me, without the overhead of a big project.

servicos.title: How I can help your company

items.title: Custom systems
items.desc: Web systems for companies with specific processes that off-the-shelf software doesn't cover.

items.title: Process automation
items.desc: Does your company still rely on spreadsheets, copy-pasting data or repeating manual tasks? I build solutions that turn these processes into faster, organized digital flows.

items.title: System integration
items.desc: When two important tools for your business don't talk to each other, I build integrations through APIs and intermediary services, cutting rework and duplicate data.
diagram: Online store → Integration → ERP → Inventory / Billing
Website form → CRM → WhatsApp / Sales team

items.title: System modernization
items.desc: Old systems can still matter to a company, but they can also hold back its growth. I work on gradually modernizing these applications, APIs, integrations and databases, without needing to rebuild everything at once.

items.title: Database migration & modernization
items.desc: Migrating a database means hundreds of tables, incompatible data types and a lot of manual validation. It's a risky process if rushed. I'm building a solution to automate much of this work, making migrations safer and more predictable.
items.ctaSub: Planning to modernize a legacy system?

cards.title: Enterprise systems
cards.body: Development and evolution of systems used internally by large organizations, integrating multiple tools and different databases. This is the quality bar I apply to every project, large or small.

cards.title: Database modernization
cards.body: Hands-on experience migrating systems from one database technology to another without stopping the business. This experience led to my own research into automating part of that process.

cards.title: BFF · Meu Vivo App
cards.body: I worked on the layer that connects the Meu Vivo app to several internal and external systems (like Salesforce), making sure the right information reaches the end user quickly, even coming from different sources.

cards.title: ConstruControl
cards.body: A process management system with secure login and access control. A personal project on GitHub as a practical demo of my work.

cards.title: CGP: Liability Management Control
cards.body: A system used by the court to control and organize financial liabilities, information that used to be harder to track and centralize.

cards.title: Collections Center
cards.body: A judicial collections system with secure authentication and integration with the court's internal databases, built to handle a high volume of cases without failing.

paraQuem.lead: My solutions make the most sense for companies that:
items: still rely heavily on Excel and manual processes
have a specific operation off-the-shelf software doesn't cover
need to build an internal system
have old systems that need modernizing
need to migrate or modernize databases
have a product idea and need to turn it into software

contato.title: Got a process that could work better?
contato.sub: If your company has a manual process, systems that don't talk to each other, or an old application that needs to evolve, let's talk about the problem before we even discuss technology. Often the solution is simpler than it looks.
